title: The Triangle That Expands (a + b)! Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Multiply (a + b) by itself five times and you fill a whole page with working. A simple triangle of numbers gives the answer in seconds: 1, 5, 10, 10, 5, 1. How can a triangle know the answer to a long multiplication? This animated lesson follows NCERT Chapter 7, Binomial Theorem (Class 11).

You will see (a + b) squared as a real square cut into pieces, then watch Pascal's triangle build itself live, each number made by adding the two above it, while the matching expansion appears beside it. We find out why it works by picking a or b from each bracket (the numbers in front are choose counts, nCr), and watch the powers of a count down and the powers of b count up. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example expanding (x + 2) to the power 4, the exam trap of signs in (a - b) cubed, an original JEE Main pattern question, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.
